title: Week in Security: Hacked freezers, Chainalysis user data exposed, Zyxel switch zero-day
description:
Three security stories from the week of November 6, 2026.

1. Hacked freezers and cold-chain systems
- On November 5, five US agencies (CISA, FBI, HHS, USDA and the Department of Transportation) warned that hackers are targeting internet-connected industrial refrigeration and cold-chain monitoring systems worldwide.
- In Europe, a second wave in November hit more than 115 stores across six countries; some units reached 50°C (122°F), according to BleepingComputer.
- In France, the national blood service EFS says an incident at a refrigeration equipment supplier changed temperature and defrost settings at three sites. EFS says no blood products were lost.

2. Chainalysis: login data for all users exposed
- The blockchain analytics firm first disclosed a breach on October 30 and said it had seen no access to credentials or session tokens.
- On November 2 it took Reactor and Data Solutions offline. On November 4 it said some passwords were exposed in an on-path attack, and later that names, usernames, password hashes and live tokens for all users were exposed.
- Chainalysis says it has no evidence that investigations data was accessed. All users must reset passwords and rotate API keys, using the login page directly rather than email links.

3. Zyxel GS1900 switches: a zero-day, not the old bug
- Almost 1,000 Zyxel GS1900 switches were hacked. The attacks were blamed on CVE-2026-7273, fixed in June, but Binarly found a previously unknown flaw: CVE-2026-107441 (CVSS 8.8), an out-of-bounds write that lets an attacker on the same network run OS commands without logging in. Ten GS1900 models are affected. Fixed firmware shipped in late October; Zyxel's advisory was published November 3.

Analyst note (Securidge analysis): attackers love devices nobody watches. If it is online, someone must own its updates.

Do this today
1. Take refrigeration controllers off the public internet.
2. Change default passwords on connected devices.
3. Update Zyxel GS1900 switch firmware.
4. Chainalysis user? Reset your password and rotate your API keys.
